title: Conformal Risk Control for QoT-Aware Lightpath Feasibility Under Technology-Driven Domain Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.13893v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML)-based regression models support operational decision-making in optical networks but typically expose only point predictions, which carry no statistically controlled information about their reliability. This paper proposes a post-hoc conformal risk control (CRC) framework that keeps a pretrained AI/ML regressor fixed, provides a finite-sample guarantee on uncertainty band miscoverage, and maps the band to operational decisions through policy rules. The guarantee applies to interval miscoverage, while decision-error rates are evaluated empirically. We instantiate the framework for quality of transmission (QoT)-aware lightpath (LP) feasibility assessment, in which a regressor predicts optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR) under domain shifts caused by fiber, amplifier, and switching upgrades. Feature shift contribution scores identify the LP features whose relation to QoT changes the most

translated_title: 技术驱动的域偏移下基于保形风险控制的QoT感知光路可行性评估
translated_abstract: 基于人工智能和机器学习（AI/ML）的回归模型能够支持光网络中的运行决策，但通常只提供点预测，缺乏统计上可控的可靠性信息。本文提出一种事后保形风险控制（CRC）框架，该框架保持预训练的AI/ML回归器不变，为不确定性区间的覆盖失败提供有限样本保证，并通过策略规则将该区间映射为运行决策。该保证适用于区间覆盖失败，而决策错误率则通过实证进行评估。我们将该框架实例化用于传输质量（QoT）感知的光路（LP）可行性评估，其中回归器在光纤、放大器和交换设备升级引起的域偏移下预测光信噪比（OSNR）。特征偏移贡献分数能够识别出与QoT关系变化最大的光路特征。
tldr: 本文提出一种事后保形风险控制框架，在保持预训练AI/ML回归模型不变的情况下，为技术升级引起域偏移时光网络QoT感知光路可行性评估的不确定性区间提供有限样本统计保证，并通过策略规则将预测区间映射为运行决策。
